description: This file contains functions and logic for creating and managing project structures within the FreeCodeCamp curriculum, including creating challenges, updating JSON metadata, and prompting user input for project configuration.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Main function to create a new project, update structures, and generate challenges based on provided arguments.

methods.name: updateIntroJson
methods.description: Updates the intro.json file with the new project title.

methods.name: createMetaJson
methods.description: Creates or updates the metadata JSON for a project block.

methods.name: createFirstChallenge
methods.description: Creates the initial challenge for a project block.

methods.name: createQuizChallenge
methods.description: Creates a quiz challenge with specified question count.

methods.name: getChapters
methods.description: Retrieves chapters for a given superblock from the curriculum structure JSON.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves modules within a chapter for a given superblock.
